about: GTA 5 (2013) still hides three secrets any owner can go see in story mode: an alien frozen under the ice in the first mission (Prologue, North Yankton), the mural in the cable car station on top of Mount Chiliad (what looks like a UFO, a cracked egg and a jetpack; meaning never settled), and Jolene Cranley-Evans' ghost on Mount Gordo from 11 PM to midnight in-game, over her husband's name 'Jock' in blood. Ends on GTA 6, Nov 19 2026 (rockstargames.com/VI). Delta, pillar 2. Sources in BRIEF.md.
